fr_html: LORD PHILLIMORE fait observer que le numérotage des articles formant la future Convention établissant la Cour sera tout à fait indépendant du numérotage de la Convention de 1907.
en_html: LORD PHILLIMORE pointed out that the numbering of the articles which were to form the new Convention establishing the Court would be quite independent of the numbering of the Convention of 1907.
